question: For carcinogenic molecules containing nitrogen, calculate the percentage that have double bonds. Then, among those molecules with nitrogen and double bonds, identify which element appears most frequently across all these molecules and count how many distinct bond types are used.

prediction.sql:
WITH carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND a.XCL_003 = 'n'
),
molecules_with_double_bonds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '='
),
percentage_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules) AS total_nitrogen,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules cnm
         JOIN molecules_with_double_bonds mdb ON cnm.molecule_id = mdb.molecule_id) AS with_double_bonds
),
nitrogen_double_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT cnm.molecule_id
    FROM carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules cnm
    JOIN molecules_with_double_bonds mdb ON cnm.molecule_id = mdb.molecule_id
),
element_counts AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_003 AS element, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM nitrogen_double_bond_molecules ndbm
    JOIN atom a ON ndbm.molecule_id = a.XCL_002
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
most_frequent_element AS (
    SELECT element, count
    FROM element_counts
    ORDER BY count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
distinct_bond_types AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.XCL_006) AS bond_type_count
    FROM nitrogen_double_bond_molecules ndbm
    JOIN bond b ON ndbm.molecule_id = b.XCL_005
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * pc.with_double_bonds / pc.total_nitrogen, 2) AS percentage_with_double_bonds,
    mfe.element AS most_frequent_element,
    mfe.count AS most_frequent_element_count,
    dbt.bond_type_count AS distinct_bond_types
FROM percentage_calc pc
CROSS JOIN most_frequent_element mfe
CROSS JOIN distinct_bond_types dbt

WITH carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND a.XCL_003 = 'n'
),
molecules_with_double_bonds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '='
),
percentage_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules) AS total_nitrogen,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules cnm
         JOIN molecules_with_double_bonds mdb ON cnm.molecule_id = mdb.molecule_id) AS with_double_bonds
),
nitrogen_double_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT cnm.molecule_id
    FROM carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules cnm
    JOIN molecules_with_double_bonds mdb ON cnm.molecule_id = mdb.molecule_id
),
element_counts AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_003 AS element, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM nitrogen_double_bond_molecules ndbm
    JOIN atom a ON ndbm.molecule_id = a.XCL_002
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
most_frequent_element AS (
    SELECT element, count
    FROM element_counts
    ORDER BY count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
distinct_bond_types AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.XCL_006) AS bond_type_count
    FROM nitrogen_double_bond_molecules ndbm
    JOIN bond b ON ndbm.molecule_id = b.XCL_005
)
SELECT

    mfe.element AS most_frequent_element,
    mfe.count AS most_frequent_element_count,
    dbt.bond_type_count AS distinct_bond_types
FROM percentage_calc pc
CROSS JOIN most_frequent_element mfe
CROSS JOIN distinct_bond_types dbt

WITH carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND a.XCL_003 = 'n'
),
molecules_with_double_bonds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '='
),
percentage_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules) AS total_nitrogen,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules cnm
         JOIN molecules_with_double_bonds mdb ON cnm.molecule_id = mdb.molecule_id) AS with_double_bonds
),
nitrogen_double_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT cnm.molecule_id
    FROM carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules cnm
    JOIN molecules_with_double_bonds mdb ON cnm.molecule_id = mdb.molecule_id
),
element_counts AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_003 AS element, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM nitrogen_double_bond_molecules ndbm
    JOIN atom a ON ndbm.molecule_id = a.XCL_002
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
most_frequent_element AS (
    SELECT element, count
    FROM element_counts
    ORDER BY count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
distinct_bond_types AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.XCL_006) AS bond_type_count
    FROM nitrogen_double_bond_molecules ndbm
    JOIN bond b ON ndbm.molecule_id = b.XCL_005
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * pc.with_double_bonds / pc.total_nitrogen, 2) AS percentage_with_double_bonds,
    mfe.element AS most_frequent_element,
    mfe.count AS most_frequent_element_count,
    dbt.bond_type_count AS distinct_bond_types
FROM percentage_calc pc
CROSS JOIN most_frequent_element mfe

WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
  WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND a.XCL_003 = 'n'
),
withdb AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
  JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
  WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND a.XCL_003 = 'n' AND b.XCL_006 = '='
)
SELECT (
  (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) FROM withdb) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base)
) || '%' || ' | ' ||
  (SELECT a.XCL_003 FROM atom a WHERE a.XCL_002 IN (SELECT XCL_010 FROM withdb) GROUP BY a.XCL_003 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) ||
  ' | ' ||
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.XCL_006) FROM bond b WHERE b.XCL_005 IN (SELECT XCL_010 FROM withdb))
